acceptance_criteria: packages/review-calibration/bin/review-calibration.mjs accepts --review-timeout <seconds> (default 300), rejects non-integer or non-positive values with opError (exit 1), and passes reviewTimeout * 1000 ms to runWithPlants.
HELP_TEXT and packages/review-calibration/README.md document --review-timeout <seconds> and note that shell:false requires invoking Node entrypoints directly on Windows rather than .cmd/.bat shims.
description: Resolves #758.
